1. Touch where you want to launch the ball
2. Match 3 or more balls of the same color to remove.
3. Swap the shooting ball by touching the shoot emitter.
4. Create powerful boosters & items to help you blast through levels.

Features
• Ultra-fast launch speed, unlimited launch quantity!
• No life limit, unlimited play!
• Tons of fun buffs!
• Hundreds of unique levels and fun challenges!
• You can play both horizontally and vertically!
• Support offline games！
